title: system2: firewall legacy continuity before NC-T01 replay certification
codepathFindings: Default buildPitReplayWindow semantics remain PRESERVE_INPUT, protecting existing PIT replay/backtest behavior.
Only the Daily Shadow path using resolveContinuityEvidence requests UNVERIFIED_UNTIL_POST_REPLAY_CERTIFICATION.
On that NC-T01 path, legacy CLEAR_NO_ACTION and ADJUSTED_CONTINUITY labels are sanitized to UNVERIFIED before replayHash/source-history identity is built.
Sanitized replay/source-history identity is invariant to the incoming legacy continuity label.
Selected revision provenance tuple remains attached after PIT revision selection.
The hotfix does not promote CLEAR_NO_ACTION; post-replay hash-bound continuity receipt remains the only promotion authority.
